errors.english: fire does not transcend being a benefactor [note: a cause] and performing the act of benefiting [note: producing an effect]
errors.why: phan gdags bya 'dogs byed is the upakārya-upakāraka relation (the benefited and the benefactor, i.e. effect and cause); the English makes both members the cause side and glosses them wrongly.

errors.english: that which can be established without relying on anything else regarding the two kinds of objects associated with meaning and cognition
errors.why: bsgrub nus pa here is the capacity to accomplish (arthakriyā) the twofold purpose relating to object and cognition independently, not 'can be established'.

note: Sound treatment of apprehension/remoteness and substance/quality; the definition of substance as causally efficacious is blurred.

errors.english: "You and the cowherd's mother will know through tranquility alone,"

mnyam pa nyid here is sameness/like-mindedness between the two minds, not equanimity (upekṣā).
